source_row.rationale: Clinical ladder programs provide a structured pathway for professional growth, recognition (often with associated compensation increases), and career advancement for experienced nurses who wish to remain in direct clinical practice rather than moving into management, supporting the retention of skilled clinicians and recognizing advanced clinical expertise.
source_row.source_detail: Structural empowerment/professional development framework supports clinical advancement and recognition without requiring management transition; accessed 2026-08-14.
